c74object.name: evi_crossover_3band
c74object.digest: evieve Gen Object. Linkwitz-Riley 3-way (low/mid/high) crossover filter
c74object.description:
evi_crossover_3band is an abstraction for using inside gen~ or GenExpr.
evi_crossover_3band.gendsp requires the GenExpr file(s):
evi_crossovers.genexpr
evi_crossover_3band is also available in MSP as: evi.crossover.3band~.
Linkwitz-Riley crossovers sum perfectly flat on recombination of the outputs (providing allpass alignment is used). Use evi.crossover.3band~ to achieve multiband processing. @see the 'seealso' section for other evieve objects that can help with this.

geninlet.name: input
geninlet.digest: to Split. Audio input to split.

geninlet.name: low
geninlet.digest: Crossover Frequency in Hz @min 10 @max 20000. The low frequency at which to split the incoming audio into it's low band and mid band outputs.

geninlet.name: high
geninlet.digest: Crossover Frequency in Hz @min 10 @max 20000. The high frequency at which to split the incoming audio into it's mid band and high band outputs.

attribute.name: align
attribute.description: Allpass alignment in this splitting stage off or on. @see 'Discussion' in the reference file for more information.

attribute.name: order
attribute.description: 0=2-pole (shallower) crossover filters, 1=4-pole (steeper) crossover filters. 2-pole can be subtle, 4-pole gives more rejection.
